body_lead: The programme integrates satellite imagery, artificial intelligence, drones and other advanced technologies with the state's existing Digital Crop Survey system to support evidence-based policymaking Bengaluru: The Karnataka government on Thursday launched the Composite Digital Crop Survey, a technology-driven initiative to improve the accuracy and reliability of agricultural data. The programme integrates satellite imagery, artificial intelligence, drones and other advanced technologies with the state's existing Digital Crop Survey system to support evidence-based policymaking.
